title: Uyilo lehlathi lokutya
description: Beka umgangatho ngomgangatho inkqubo yokutya enemigangatho emininzi, ukusuka kwisithsaba somthi ophakamileyo ukuya kwizityalo ezingcambu.

lessons.title: Imigangatho esixhenxe: indlela ihlathi eziondla ngayo
lessons.body:
Ihlathi lomdabu lizalisa indawo ukusuka kumasebe aphezulu ukuya kwiingcambu.

Izityalo ezahlukeneyo zisebenzisa ukukhanya nokumanzi okukhoyo kumgangatho wazo.

Ihlathi lokutya liyayixelisa le ndlela ngezityalo ezivelisayo.

Isiphumo asiyiyo isityalo esinye kumqolo omnye, kodwa yimigangatho emininzi eluncedo ekhula ndawonye.

Cinga ngesithsaba somthi esiphakamileyo, imithi emincinci, amatyholo (ama-shrub) nezityalo ezingenamthi ezithambileyo.

Izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba ziwukhusela ngaphezulu, izityalo ezingcambu zikhula ngaphantsi kwawo, kwaye izityalo ezinyukayo zisebenzisa izixhasi ezifanelekileyo.

Ubude nokwahlukana kwezityalo kuxhomekeke kwizityalo nakwindawo. Le yimigangatho yocwangciso, ayizizo iibhanti zobude ezimiselweyo.

Umzekelo wokuqala we-Highveld uquka i-Wild Fig okanye i-pecan ngaphezu kwe-lemon, i-naartjie ne-black mulberry.

Ubeka i-Cape gooseberry ne-Wild Medlar kunye nemifuno, i-wild garlic, ubhatata ne-granadilla.

Thatha oku njengomzekelo wocwangciso, hayi imvume yokutyala zonke iintlobo. Qala ngokuqinisekisa ukuba sisiphi isityalo, ukumelana neqabaka, ubungakanani xa sele sikhulile, nezithintelo zasekuhlaleni.

Izityalo ezincinci zidinga ukunyanyekelwa ekusekweni kwazo: ukuhlola ukumanzi, ukulawula ukhula nokukhuselwa ekonzakaleni.

Njengoko izityalo zikhula, umthunzi namagqabi awileyo ayaguqula iimeko ezingaphantsi kwazo.

Hlola ukukhuphisana nendlela yokufikelela. Sika, nciphisa okanye hlengahlengisa ukutyala kwemigangatho engaphantsi xa oko ukubonayo kufuna; inkqubo ayiphelelwa kukudinga ukunyanyekelwa ngomhla othile omiselweyo.
keyPoints: Imigangatho esixhenxe yocwangciso inokudibanisa izityalo eziluncedo zobude obahlukeneyo
Ukunyanyekelwa ekusekweni nasemva koko kuxhomekeke kwiimeko ezibonwayo
Qinisekisa ukuba ifanelekile kwindawo yakho ngaphambi kokulandela nawuphi na umzekelo wokutyala

quiz.q: Ukhula lukhuphisana kakhulu nezityalo ezincinci zemigangatho engaphantsi. Yintoni ekufuneka ikhokele inyathelo elilandelayo?
options: Linda de kube ngunyaka wesihlanu
Yongeza izityalo ngaphandle kokucinga ngamanzi
Hlola izityalo ezichaphazelekayo ulawule ukukhuphisana
Cinga ukuba yonke imigangatho esixhenxe iyazinyamekela
quiz.rationale: Qwalasela ukukhuphisana okwenzekayo nemeko yezityalo. Ikhalenda emiselweyo yokusekwa ayinakukuxelela ukuba zeziphi izityalo ezidinga ukunyanyekelwa ngoku.

quiz.q: Amagqabi awileyo nomthunzi anganceda njani ekukhuseleni ukumanzi komhlaba?
options: Aqinisekisa ukufikelela kumanzi angaphantsi komhlaba
Anganciphisa ukulahlekelwa ngamanzi kumphezulu womhlaba
Aqinisekisa isivuno esiphezulu ngelitha ngalinye kuyo yonke inkqubo
Asusa isidingo sokuhlola ukunkcenkceshela
quiz.rationale: Umthunzi nengca yokugquma efanelekileyo inganciphisa umphunga ovela kumphezulu womhlaba. Isidingo sezityalo samanzi neemfuno zokusekwa zisadinga ingqalelo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Isahlulo esinqunyiweyo sehlathi lokutya esinomthi omkhulu omi phakathi, imithi emincinci, amatyholo, izityalo ezime nkqo, izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba nesityalo esinyukayo, iingcambu zazo zisasazeka emhlabeni; ukukhanya kwelanga kungena ngasekhohlo ngaphezulu.

lessons.title: Ukukhetha iintlobo zezityalo zamahlathi okutya aseMzantsi Afrika
lessons.body:
Hlola imvula, iqabaka, ubushushu, umhlaba nokufumaneka kwamanzi kwindawo yakho ngaphambi kokukhetha izityalo.

I-mango inokonakaliswa liqabaka. I-quince idinga ubusika obubandayo ngokufanelekileyo ukuze izale ngokuthembekileyo.

Igama lommandla okanye ikona ekhuselekileyo ayiyonto eyaneleyo. Qinisekisa isityalo ngasinye nohlobo ngalunye ngesikhokelo esithembekileyo sasekuhlaleni.

Uluhlu lokuqala luquka pecan, walnut nekhiwane lomdabu; apple, pear, plum, black mulberry ne-loquat; rosemary, Wild Medlar, Cape gooseberry ne-Barbados cherry.

Olu luhlu aluyiyo ingcebiso yazo zonke. Hlola isityalo ngasinye ngokuhambelana neqabaka, umhlaba, ubungakanani xa sele sikhulile noluhlu lweentlobo ezivunyiweyo zasekuhlaleni.

Gcina izithintelo ezikhoyo zomthetho nezeprojekthi zisebenza. Ungatyali ngokubona ifoto kuphela.

Imizekelo yokuqala yeendawo ezishushu iquka mango, avocado, Natal Mahogany, banana, pawpaw, litchi, Wild Fig, Barbados cherry ne-Wild Dagga.

Marula, Mopane ne-baobab nazo zivela kwimizekelo yaseLimpopo. Ukufaneleka kwindawo yakho kusafuna ukuhlolwa.

Imithi eluncedo ayizizo ngokuzenzekelayo ezityiwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba sisiphi isityalo nokusetyenziswa kwaso ngokukhuselekileyo; ifoto yembonakalo yomhlaba ayisosikhokelo sokuchonga ukutya.

Izityalo zomdabu ezifanelekileyo kwindawo zinokuxhasa indawo yokuhlala yezilwanyana zasendle njengenxalenye yoyilo.

Khetha ngokwendalo yendawo yakho nangendima eluncedo yesityalo ngasinye. Akukho njongo yepesenti esekelwe kumthombo othembekileyo kwesi sifundo.

Khusela izityalo zendalo ezikhoyo. Musa ukuguqula amathafa aphilileyo abe lihlathi lokutya ngenxa nje yokuba imithi iluncedo kwenye indawo.
keyPoints: Fanisa isityalo ngasinye nohlobo ngalunye nendawo yokwenyani
Hlola ukuchongwa, ukusetyenziswa okukhuselekileyo nezithintelo zangoku zasekuhlaleni
Umzekelo wommandla awuyomvume yazo zonke iintlobo ezikuluhlu lwawo
Sebenzisa izityalo zomdabu ezifanelekileyo kwaye ukhusele indawo yokuhlala yendalo ekhoyo

quiz.q: Umlimi ufuna ukutyala i-mango encinci apho kwenzeka iqabaka eliqatha. Yeyiphi ingozi efuna ingqalelo?
options: Iyaphumelela — indawo ivala impembelelo yeqabaka
Izala kwangoko ngenxa yotshintsho lobushushu
Kunokwenzeka kakhulu ukuba ibulawe okanye yonakaliswe kakhulu liqabaka, ngakumbi njengomthi omncinci
Iyasinda ngengca yokugquma ekhulu kodwa idinga ukutshintshwa unyaka ngamnye
quiz.rationale: I-mango encinci inokonakaliswa liqabaka. Hlola iimeko zendawo yakho yokwenyani nesikhokelo sasekuhlaleni esithembekileyo, kunokuba ucinge ukuba indawo ekhuselekileyo isusa ingozi.

quiz.q: Kutheni kufakwa izityalo zomdabu ezifanelekileyo kuyilo?
options: Ngamaxesha onke zivelisa ukutya okuninzi ngemitha yesikwere nganye
Zinokuxhasa indawo yokuhlala yasekuhlaleni, izinambuzane ezithwala umungu nezinye izilwanyana zasendle
Zonke iintlobo ezizisiweyo azikho mthethweni
Azisoze zidinge ukunyanyekelwa ekusekweni
quiz.rationale: Khetha izityalo ngokwendalo yasekuhlaleni nangendima yazo. Oku akumiseli peresenti esebenza kuyo yonke indawo kwaye akususi isidingo sokuhlola ukufaneleka.

lessons.infographicAlt: Imilo elula yoMzantsi Afrika ahlulwe yaba yimimandla emithathu yokukhula ngombala womhlaba nemo yomhlaba kuphela: ithafa eliphakamileyo elisemaphakathi elinombala okhanyayo elinamagquma, umgca oluhlaza onomswakama osecaleni kolwandle, nendawo eshushu ephantsi ebomvu-mdaka. Kwenye nenye kume iimilo zemithi ezahlukeneyo.

lessons.title: Ukusekwa kwehlathi lokutya: jonga kwaye uhlengahlengise
lessons.body:
Qala ngokuhlola indawo, unikezelo lwamanzi nokhathalelo olukhoyo. Khusela umhlaba ongagqunyiwe kwangoko.

Izityalo zenkxaso zethutyana zinokunika indawo yokukhuselwa nezinto eziluncedo ezisikiweyo apho kufanelekileyo.

Imithi ephambili nemigangatho esezantsi inokufakwa njengoko iimeko zivuma. Izityalo ezigubungela umhlaba akuyomfuneko ukuba zilinde de kube sekupheleni; phepha ukuba izityalo zikhuphisane nemithi emincinci.

Qala ngendawo onokuyinkcenkceshela uyigcine. Hlola izityalo ezikhoyo ngaphambi kokucoca.

Apho kufanelekileyo, ikhadibhodi eqhelekileyo phantsi kwengca yokugquma efanelekileyo inganciphisa ukukhula okungafunwayo. Gcina amanzi anokungena emhlabeni uzishiye iziqu zemithi zicocekile.

Cwangcisa ukwahlukana ngokobungakanani bezityalo xa sele zikhulile. Lungiselela izityalo zasenkulisweni (i-nursery) kwithuba elilandelayo elifanelekileyo lokutyala.

Khangela indlela umthunzi, iingcambu namanzi akhoyo achaphazela ngayo izityalo ezingabamelwane.

I-comfrey ne-wild garlic zivela kumzekelo wokuqala wokutyala ngaphantsi; hlola ukufaneleka kwazo kwindawo yakho ngaphambi kokuzisebenzisa.

Sika okanye nciphisa izityalo zenkxaso xa kuyimfuneko, usebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo kuhlobo ngalunye. Izinqumlo ezicocekileyo ezifanelekileyo zinokubuyela njengengca yokugquma. Ungalindi unyaka othile omiselweyo ukuba ukukhuphisana sele kuzonakalisa izityalo.

Khetha ithuba lokutyala xa ukumanzi komhlaba nemozulu elindelekileyo zixhasa ukusekwa.

Imvula inganceda, kodwa hlola indawo yeengcambu kwaye uhlale unesicwangciso sokunkcenkceshela esilindileyo (i-backup). Phepha ukutyala emhlabeni ozele ngamanzi.

Hlola izityalo ezincinci emva kokutyala. Ixesha lokuvuna nezinto ezongezwa zivela ngaphandle zixhomekeke kuhlobo lwesityalo, indawo nokhathalelo; akukho sivuno siqinisekisiweyo kunyaka wesihlanu.
keyPoints: Hlola ukumanzi kwindawo yeengcambu nangexesha leemvula
Lawula ukukhuphisana njengoko kuvela; imihla yokuvuna ayiqinisekisiwe

quiz.q: Umfama ubeka ikhadibhodi eqhelekileyo phantsi kwengca yokugquma efanelekileyo apho kukhula ingca. Inganceda ngantoni?
options: Yenza isithintelo somswakama esivala amanzi ukuba angangeni emhlabeni
Ivala ukukhanya kwaye incede ukucinezela ingca ngelixa ibola; hlola ukuba ayikhuli kwakhona
Inika isiseko esizinzileyo ukuze iitshiphusi zomthi zingashukumi
Ibuyisela ubushushu phezulu ukufudumeza umhlaba
quiz.rationale: Ikhadibhodi phantsi kwengca yokugquma efanelekileyo inokuvala ukukhanya inciphise ukukhula kwengca. Ingca ekhoyo inokukhula kwakhona, ngoko hlola indawo. Gcina amanzi enokungena emhlabeni nengca yokugquma ikude neziqu.

quiz.q: Umlimi kufuneka acinge nini ukusika okanye ukuncitshisa izityalo zenkxaso zethutyana?
options: Kuphela ngomhla womnyaka othile omiselweyo
Xa ukukhuphisana okubonwayo kuyifuna, kusetyenziswa iindlela ezifanelekileyo kuhlobo
Ngokukhawuleza xa kuwa nasiphi na isagqabi
Soze kufuneke, kuba izityalo zenkxaso azikwazi ukukhuphisana
quiz.rationale: Izityalo zenkxaso zethutyana zinokuba ngabakhuphisana. Qwalasela ukukhanya, amanzi nokukhula, uze ukhethe indlela efanelekileyo yolawulo kunokuba ulinde unyaka othile omiselweyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Icandelo elinye lomhlaba kwizigaba ezine, ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene: ingca yokugquma ekhululekileyo isasazwa phezu kwekhadibhodi emhlabeni, emva koko izityalo zokuqala eziphantsi ezikhula ngokukhawuleza, emva koko imithi encinci yesithsaba kunye nemigangatho esezantsi izaliswa, ekugqibeleni ukutyala okunemigangatho okuzinzileyo.
